newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen continuing their rally.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen continuing their rally.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to continue their rally amid buying by both retail and institutional investors, brokers said.
"The upward trend of the shares may continue as many of the scrips that have strong economic fundamentals are still attractive to the investors," said broker Moshtaque Ahmed.
Brokers said investors were returning after they gained confidence following the recent overhaul of the bourse, which brought changes in the bourse governing council.
The DSE index rose 39.18 points or 3.29 percent at 1,227.02 on Saturday. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
